defaultValue: Not everyone can turn their arm far enough to see a watch straight on. Lean turns the time instead, so it meets your eye at the angle your wrist naturally comes to rest.

options.label: Left wrist  ·  the time turns clockwise
Right wrist  ·  the time turns counter-clockwise

items.label: Tilt
items.description: In degrees. 0 keeps the time upright. Raise your wrist as you normally would and pick the value at which the digits look level to you.

items.label: Worn upside down
items.description: Turns the time by another 180 degrees, for wearing the watch the other way round. Leave it off if your watch already turns the whole display.

items.label: Show the date
items.description: Weekday and day, turned with the time. They go wherever the most space is left - side by side, stacked, or apart if that leaves noticeably more room.

items.defaultValue: If both colours match, the watch falls back to a legible one. 12 or 24 hour format follows your watch setting.
